boundaries.first_group: The six entries are independently bounded by their exact VM terminators and adjacent known roots. 0x00121F6A, 0x00121F74, and 0x00121FA0 are 10, 16, and 6 bytes respectively; 0x00121F84 ends before the separate 0x00121F9C state bytes; 0x00121FA6 ends immediately before 0x00121FD4; 0x00121FD4 ends immediately before PLAYER_ANIM_RUN at 0x00122006.

conclusion: The post-idle player state block is a set of distinct landing and terrain-response entries rather than one anonymous stream. Special-camera grounding uses a short prelude into the special-camera locomotion loop; ordinary landing clears the player animation fields before dynamic selection; horizontal terrain response has its own timed, sound-producing loop; and the grounded recovery entry is a separate two-frame tail. No runtime or native behavior is inferred beyond the static selector contracts.
